page: Microsoft Azure EC64es_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the ECEV5 server family. It is configured with 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met using external volumes, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. Additionally, there are no integrated graphics processing units and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with the deployment.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU positions this server for memory-intensive workloads rather than compute-bound or graphics-heavy tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities. This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
